subject: Integrated SKU mapping and commission framework for ISV bundles
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@forgeworks.io>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Integrated SKU mapping and commission proposal

Hi Ava / Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ForgeWorks is excited about packaging a joint offering with Redwood where our connector + your Hosted API are sold as a single SKU to mid-market analytics teams. Attached is a first-pass SKU mapping and suggested commission matrix (integrated-sku-proposal-v1.pdf, commission-matrix.xlsx).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirmation of commission tiers for bundled SKUs (we proposed 12% standard, 18% for certified partners).
- Lead registration protection rules — we generally ask for 90 days but are open to compromise.
- Certification gating: full rev-share only after partner passes technical certification and a post-integration QA checklist.

We want to pilot with two accounts this quarter. Can Redwood confirm whether commission payments can be split monthly vs quarterly and whether onboarding credits (one-time) can be escrowed against churn in the first 90 days?

Attachment stubs: integrated-sku-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf), commission-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Strategic Partnerships
ForgeWorks
---

From: ava_chen@redwood.ai
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@forgeworks.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Integrated SKU mapping and commission proposal

Hi Sasha — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Quick reactions below; I'll loop in Finance/Legal after we settle the commercial shape.

1) Commission tiers: Redwood is comfortable with a two-tier approach but propose slightly different %s to keep unit economics healthy. Suggested: 10% standard, 16% certified partner revshare. Certified partner defined as passing the integration QA checklist and a joint customer success playbook.

2) Lead registration window: We prefer 60 days for auto-approval; longer windows are OK for special deals but require explicit registration via our partner portal. We can add an exceptions process for strategic pilots.

3) Onboarding credits escrow: We can support a time-limited credit hold tied to pilot milestones (e.g., 50% released at go-live, remainder released after 90-day revenue verification). Finance will need the pilot account IDs and expected MRR to size the hold.

Operational asks from our side:
- Need a machine-readable SKU mapping (CSV) so our billing pipeline can map partner SKUs to Redwood product SKUs.
- Commission payments: Redwood prefers monthly settlement with net-30; quarterly is acceptable for larger gov/enterprise buys.

I've attached a redline-style commission matrix (commission-matrix.xlsx) with the changes marked. Can you confirm you can accept the certified-partner definition and the 60-day registration window?

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
---

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@forgeworks.io>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Integrated SKU mapping and commission proposal

Sasha — quick ops/finance notes (quoting Ava below):

> 2) Lead registration window: We prefer 60 days for auto-approval; longer windows are OK for special deals but require explicit registration via our partner portal.

Operational constraints we need to handle if we accept 60-day auto-approval:
- Lead ingestion: ForgeWorks will need to push leads into our partner portal with source metadata (origin, initial contact date, region).
- Duplicate protection: if a lead already exists in Redwood CRM, our system will flag it and require SDR validation within 3 business days.
- Escrow and onboarding credits: Finance requires a signed MOU for any credit hold > $10k. For pilots under $10k, we can handle credit adjustments in the first invoice.

A couple of asks for ForgeWorks:
- Can you confirm the API client ids that will be used for mapping partner SKUs (we need immutable identifiers)?
- For certified-partner status, implement a post-deploy webhook so our systems can verify certification state automatically.

Attachment: I included a short ops checklist in the commission-matrix.xlsx tab called "ops-todo".

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
---

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@forgeworks.io>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Greene <t.greene@signalbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Integrated SKU mapping and commission proposal

Thanks Ben and Ava — appreciate the specificity. A few confirmations from ForgeWorks: 

- We can accept the certified-partner definition as written. Our engineering team will expose a /certification webhook and include the connector client_id values in the CSV export.
- Lead push: we'll add the required metadata fields in the partner lead payload and include a utm_source of "forgeworks-partner" for easier dedup checks.
- Onboarding credit: we agree to an MOU for pilots where Redwood holds > $10k. For the two pilot accounts we propose, expected onboarding spend is $6k and $8k respectively — so we can proceed without a formal MOU.

Tom from SignalBridge (cc'd) will help coordinate the first pilot account introductions — Tom, can you share the account SLAs and the expected go-live windows?

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood to share final commission matrix and partner portal registration URL.
2) ForgeWorks to provide CSV mapping and webhook endpoint by EOD Friday.
3) Joint pilot kickoff call next Tuesday to walk technical checklist.

Thanks,
Sasha
---

From: ava_chen@redwood.ai
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@forgeworks.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tom.greene@signalbridge.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Integrated SKU mapping and commission proposal

All — confirming next steps and owners. A short mutual action plan below.

Mutual action plan (timeline in parentheses):
- Redwood: publish finalized commission matrix and partner portal registration link (Nov 13) — owner: Marissa Cole.
- ForgeWorks: deliver CSV SKU mapping + webhook endpoint details (Nov 13 EOD) — owner: Sasha Ivanov.
- Joint: Pilot kickoff call (Nov 16) — owner: Ava Chen. Agenda: review ops checklist, agree cert test cases, confirm pilot accounts and MRR assumptions.

Notes:
- Lead registration: 60-day auto-approval as default; strategic exceptions require manual approval.
- Commission payments: monthly net-30 for pilot; Finance to confirm payment cadence for production deals.
- Onboarding credits: hold release split (50% at go-live, 50% after 90-day verification) for these pilots.

Attachments referenced: integrated-sku-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal), commission-matrix.xlsx (redline + ops checklist).

If that looks good to everyone, I'll send a calendar invite for Nov 16 and loop in Legal for a short SOW covering the pilot terms.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
